Free for patients

Get your own health records fast

Your complete medical history already exists in health plans, EHRs, and the national network. You just can't access it yet.

Flexpa pulls your medications, conditions, lab results, claims, and coverage into one place. Then it generates a secure QR code you can show at any doctor's office so they get your full history instantly, and you never fill out another form.

The clipboard is broken

Every doctor visit starts the same way. It doesn't have to.

Paper at best, fax at worst

The Same Forms. Every Visit.

Name, date of birth, medications, allergies, past surgeries. You've written it a hundred times. Your records already exist digitally.

Silos

Records Everywhere, Access Nowhere

Five portals, five passwords, five different interfaces. None of them talk to each other.

Risk

Critical Details Get Lost

Handwritten forms lead to errors. Missed allergies, wrong dosages, incomplete history. A real risk to your care.

Everything on the clipboard. And more.

Your health plans, EHRs, and exchanges already hold a comprehensive picture of your care. Flexpa puts it all in your hands.

Medications

Every prescription, dosage, and refill across all your providers in one chronological view

Allergies

Drug, food, and environmental allergies with documented reactions so new providers never have to guess

Conditions

Active and resolved diagnoses pulled from claims and clinical records across your entire care history

Coverage

Your insurance plan details, benefits, copays, and deductible status from your health plan

Labs & Vitals

Blood work, imaging results, vitals, and observations from every lab and provider visit

Claims & EOBs

Complete billing history with Explanations of Benefits so you can see what was charged and what was covered

Immunizations

Your full vaccination record including dates, manufacturers, and lot numbers for travel or school requirements

Visits

Every encounter, hospital stay, and office visit with dates, providers, and clinical notes when available

Built on trust and compliance

Your data is protected by the same standards used across the healthcare industry

Security & Privacy

Your data is encrypted in transit and at rest. SMART Health Links are passcode-protected with expiration controls, and you can revoke access anytime. We are SOC II certified, TEFCA participants, and signatories to the CARIN Code of Conduct.

SOC II Certified

Independent verification of security controls

TEFCA Participant
